en:
This is amazing...
It's like an event venue!

<CLT=cltMIND>That must mean this is the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Cosplayer<CLT=cltMIND>'s lab.

Umm...even with all these materials and 
tools, if it's by myself...

I see...
Cosplay is fun to do with others, right?
There's no point doing it by myself...

Hey, Shuichi! Do you want to give it a try!?
Come on, try cosplaying with me!
M-Me!?

Yeah, I think it's just plain fun 
to become fictional characters.

To become a completely different person and
feel like you're part of a different world...

Doesn't that sound interesting?
Don't you want to live in a fictional world?
Ah, but...I'm investigating right now...

Then, let's do it later.
Let me know when you feel up to it.

I'll help you become your favorite character,
whether it's from an anime, manga, or game.

However, even if you're just trying it out, 
you gotta cosplay with love!
R-Right...

I think it's just plain fun to
become fictional characters.

I'll help you become your favorite character,
whether it's from an anime, manga, or game.

However, even if you're just trying it out, 
you gotta cosplay with love!
R-Right...
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll investigate around here a little more.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us,
but why is it so...gaudy?

<CLT=cltMIND>And it's not just the monitor,
it's this entire academy.
<CLT=cltMIND>What is going on here...?
<CLT=cltMIND>This is a set for photoshoots, huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>There are a bunch of backdrops here.
This is an incredible setup...

<CLT=cltMIND>This looks like a bar...
Is this a set too?

Well, what do you know...it's just like 
the real thing.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi spoke cheerily and sat down
at the table in front of the counter.

Hey, Shuichi, are you thirsty? I can make you
one of my signature cocktails if you'd like.
A signature cocktail?

Yeah, it seems like all the drinks here
are top-quality stuff.

I used to make them a lot at my part-time job.
Don't worry. It'll be non-alcoholic, of course.

Ah, okay...
I'll take one.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*clink, clink*

How would you like it?
A little stronger, maybe?
Huh? Ah, sure...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*clink, clink*
Wow, you're good at this, aren't you?

Yeah, before I got sponsors for my 
cosplaying, I worked a bunch of jobs.
I used to say to my customers...

"I'm in a bit of financial trouble.
If only someone could help me out..."
What?

<CLT=cltMIND>What is this feeling...?
I suddenly feel charitable!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*clink, clink*
Okay, it's ready.
Thank you.

<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of part time job did she
have, anyway? Mixing drinks like this...?

<CLT=cltMIND>With those thoughts swirling around my
head, I drank the drink Tsumugi handed to me.
Please come again.
Yes, thank you. I'll be back.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is a pretty realistic bar set...
There's liquid in the bottles, too.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi said she'd worked in a
place like this before.

<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of part time job did she
have, anyway? Mixing drinks like this...?

<CLT=cltMIND>This is another set for photoshoots...
It has quite the gothic feel.

<CLT=cltMIND>A sewing machine and work table.
Perhaps a space to make and repair costumes?

Alright, I've finished investigating all
the items this time.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito should be waiting in the dining
hall. I should gather everyone there.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spoke with everyone and told them
to gather at the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>After a time, everyone had
gathered in the dining hall.
